draft: Authenticated + unknown active_project -> 200 + JSON (falls back to factory_template project)
user_id derived from session, never from form
draft_snapshot = current form snapshot (collected in service via deps.collect_form_snapshot)
saved_snapshot = existing.saved_snapshot OR project baseline_snapshot OR default
active_scenario_id = existing.active_scenario_id OR form.get('current_saved_scenario_id', '') or None
No snapshot key in response, no HX-Trigger, no template render, no HX-Redirect
discard: Authenticated + unknown active_project -> 200 + JSON (falls back to factory_template project)
user_id derived from session, never from form
If discard_workspace_draft returns None, save_workspace_state fallback called once (via deps.save_workspace_state)
Fallback uses draft_snapshot = saved_snapshot = baseline_snapshot, dirty = False
Response message is a fixed string
No HX-Trigger, no template render, no HX-Redirect

remaining_risks: The new module adds one more service file to maintain. This is a small cost compared to the benefit of separating data-layer (scenario_state_service.py) from route-orchestration (scenario_state_route_service.py) concerns.
The 51H-1 latent-bug tests were updated to look at the service for orchestration (deps.* calls instead of bare module-level calls). Future refactors must preserve the deps.* pattern in the service.

The ScenarioStateRouteOutcome dataclass is designed for JSON-only responses. If a future scenario-state route needs to return an HTMX-rendered template, the outcome would need additional fields (template_name, template_context, etc.). For now, the dataclass is intentionally minimal.

Both routes are JSON-only (not HTMX-partial-based). This is a meaningful difference from /run, /save-run, /compare, /validate, /download (all of which return HTMX-rendered templates). The 51H-2 extraction preserves this pattern.

discard_workspace_draft is a thin repository function that internally calls save_workspace_state. The discard service therefore does 1-2 writes per call (1 always, plus 1 fallback only when discard returns None). This is the intended behavior (preserved in 51H-1 quirks 6 and 8).

There is no ScenarioStateRouteDeps.validate_form field. The scenario-state routes do NOT validate the form (Phase 51H-1 quirk 11) — they accept any form input as a snapshot. If a future refactor needs form validation, a new dep field would be needed.
All 12 behavior quirks are pinned at the orchestration level (in the service). 51H-2 preserves them; future refactors must keep them as a unit.

The discard fallback save_workspace_state uses 16-space indent for the replay_metadata_for_project call (inside the if-block which is inside execute_discard_route). 51H-1 tests are updated to match this formatting.
recommended_next_phase: Phase 51I-1 + 51I-2 (project save-as service family: /projects/{project_code}/save-as, /projects/create) is the natural next extraction. After 51I-2: optional Phase 51J (structural guardrail: export_service.py / export_audit_service.py does NOT import main_web). The /run, /compare, /validate, /download, /save-run, /scenarios/state/* families (Phases 51A-51H-2) now serve as the canonical templates for vertical extraction, with a known narrow bugfix phase pattern for any latent bugs discovered along the way.
